text: Qiqi — Hello: I am Qiqi. I am a zombie. And I... forgot what comes next.
Qiqi — Chat: Talking to Herself: Hey, do you know what? Uhh... neither do I. I... already forgot.
Qiqi — Chat: Afraid of Heat: Let's go somewhere cooler.
Qiqi — Chat: Training: One, two, three, four. Two, two, three, four...
Qiqi — When It Rains: I forgot my umbrella again.
Qiqi — When It Snows: I want to build a snowman. Will you help?
Qiqi — When the Sun Is Out: I should have stayed indoors today.
Qiqi — When It's Windy: The wind is... frigid. I like it.
Qiqi — When the Wind Is Blowing: Hold my hand please. This wind could blow me away.
Qiqi — Good Morning: Morning means it's time to check my diary. Because my diary reminds me what I'm supposed to do in the morning.
Qiqi — Good Afternoon: I just remembered something. I forgot to help Dr. Baizhu prepare medications.
Qiqi — Good Evening: Good evening. How was your day? My day was... fine, I think. But I can't remember.
Qiqi — Good Night: It's time for you to sleep now. I will do my stretches. ...Do not watch me, please.
Qiqi — About {name}: Did you ask me something? Sorry... I forgot.
Qiqi — About Us: Memory: I have a poor memory for most things. But as far as I know, that doesn't matter.
Qiqi — About Us: Memory Training: I started memory training exercises recently. So don't worry, I won't forget who you are.
Qiqi — About the [[Vision]]: My Vision can't turn back time. But at least it gives me the power to protect the people that matter most.
Qiqi — Something to Share: I may be a corpse, but I am in much better physical condition than Dr. Baizhu.
Qiqi — Interesting Things: Sometimes I see finches near the pharmacy. A nice little group of finches.
Qiqi — About [[Baizhu]]: I can never remember Dr. Baizhu's face. But I don't mind.
Qiqi — About [[Hu Tao]]: Warm. Fake smile. Death. I despise Hu Tao.
Qiqi — About [[Xiao]]: Name: Sounds like a historical artifact to me.
Qiqi — About Xiao: Memory: Remind me, have I met him before?
Qiqi — About [[Yaoyao]]: Cute. Like a nice little finch.
Qiqi — About [[Dusky Ming]]: On some nights, I almost feel like someone is doing stretches together with me. But maybe I just have an overactive imagination.
Qiqi — About [[Prune]]: She looks tough on the outside... but her palms are nice and soft. I like her.
Qiqi — More About {name}: I: What's going on?

Qiqi — More About {name}: II: I perform stretches regularly to help me maintain the same range of movement as a normal human being. But as soon as I stop doing them, the rigor mortis starts to set in again.
Qiqi — More About {name}: III: Some people want to take advantage of me. Others are terrified of me. But you... You are not like any of those people.

Qiqi — More About {name}: IV: Since we first met, I have had a warm feeling inside. Not the kind of warmth that makes me feel rotten. The other kind of warm. The one that happens inside my heart. Thank you. I am happy. Sadly I only recognize the current you. If I forget you... No. I will order myself to remember you.

Qiqi — More About {name}: V: In the past, my only thought was: I must stay alive. Even though I didn't know what to live for. But now, I think I know. I want to live with you. I want to ask, can we stay together, for the rest of life, until death? Yes or no? Yes? Is that your real answer? Good, excellent. I promise to always protect you.
Qiqi — {name}'s Hobbies: I want to have a pet. For example, a nice little finch.
Qiqi — {name}'s Troubles: I don't know why, but high temperatures make me feel... disgusting.
Qiqi — Favorite Food: I like coconut milk... But, I don't know what it tastes like.
Qiqi — Least Favorite Food: Sorry, I have no idea.
Qiqi — Receiving a Gift: I: Cold. I like it. But, no flavor...
Qiqi — Receiving a Gift: III: It's burning my tongue...

Qiqi — Birthday: Many happy returns. Here is a bag of herbal medicine for you. You must be very surprised that I remembered? Let me explain. Last time you told me, I wrote your birthday down on a piece of paper. If I look at something once a day, it eventually goes into my long-term memory, and it will stay there forever.
Qiqi — Feelings About Ascension: Intro: Now, I have more power. But... what does that mean? Please explain. Thank you.
Qiqi — Feelings About Ascension: Building Up: Ah, I understand. When I get stronger, I need to put more effort into controlling my strength.
Qiqi — Feelings About Ascension: Climax: In the past, I did not understand the idea of being stronger than I already was. Now that I understand it well, I wish I was just a little stronger still.
Qiqi — Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion: All of this is because of you. Thank you very much. Can you make me a promise? From now on, please, let me protect you. Do you accept? Yes or no? }}
